∀ (m n : ℕ), m ≠ 0 → ∀ (e d : ℤ), e ≠ 0 → ↑(m * n * e.natAbs) ∣ ↑m * e * d → ↑n ∣ d

{G : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Group G] →
      [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] →
        [inst_2 : CommGroup M] →
          [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] →
            [inst_4 : IsTopologicalGroup M] → [inst_5 : MulDistribMulAction G M] → ℕ → ContH1 G M →* ContH1 G M

∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup M] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace M] [IsTopologicalGroup M] (u : ℕ),
  Continuous fun a => a ^ u

∀ {G : Type u_2} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : CommGroup M] [inst_2 : MulDistribMulAction G M] (u : ℕ)
  (g : G) (z : M), (g • z) ^ u = g • z ^ u

∀ {G : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_2 : CommGroup M]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_4 : IsTopologicalGroup M] [inst_5 : MulDistribMulAction G M] (u : ℕ)
  (c : ContH1 G M), (CoreAnchoredComparison.coefficientPower u) c = c ^ u

∀ {G : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_2 : CommGroup M]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_4 : IsTopologicalGroup M] [inst_5 : MulDistribMulAction G M] (u : ℕ),
  CoreAnchoredComparison.coefficientPower u = ContH1.map (MonoidHom.id G) ⋯ (powMonoidHom u) ⋯ ⋯

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (x y : Kˣ),
  CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑(x * y) = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x + CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (N m u : ℕ) [inst_4 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots N K Ω]
  (x y q r c d : Kˣ),
  v ↑c = 1 →
    v ↑d = 1 →
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑r →
        (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) (x ^ m) = (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) c * (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) (y ^ m) ^ u →
          (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) q = (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) d * (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) r ^ u →
            ↑N ∣
              ↑m * CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q *
                (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y)

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (m n u : ℕ),
  m ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (x y q r c d : Kˣ),
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q ≠ 0 →
        v ↑c = 1 →
          v ↑d = 1 →
            CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑r →
              ∀ [inst_4 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω],
                (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y).natAbs < n →
                  (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) (x ^ m) =
                      (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) c *
                        (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) (y ^ m) ^ u →
                    (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) q =
                        (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) d *
                          (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) r ^ u →
                      ↑x • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v = ↑y • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (N m u : ℕ) [inst_4 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots N K Ω]
  (x y q r : Kˣ),
  CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑r →
    (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) (x ^ m) = (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) (y ^ m) ^ u →
      (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) q = (KummerTheory.kummer N K Ω) r ^ u →
        ↑N ∣
          ↑m * CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y)

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (m n u : ℕ),
  m ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (x y q r : Kˣ),
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q ≠ 0 →
        CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑r →
          ∀ [inst_4 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω],
            (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) (x ^ m) =
                (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) (y ^ m) ^ u →
              (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) q =
                  (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) r ^ u →
                ↑n ∣ CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (m n u : ℕ),
  m ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (x y q r : Kˣ),
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q ≠ 0 →
        CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑r →
          ∀ [inst_4 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω],
            (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y).natAbs < n →
              (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) (x ^ m) =
                  (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) (y ^ m) ^ u →
                (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) q =
                    (KummerTheory.kummer (m * n * (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs) K Ω) r ^ u →
                  ↑x • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v = ↑y • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (m ell : ℕ),
  m ≠ 0 →
    1 < ell →
      ∀ (x y q r : Kˣ),
        CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q ≠ 0 →
          CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑r →
            ∀ (roots : ∀ (k : ℕ), KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots (ell ^ k) K Ω),
              (∀ (k : ℕ),
                  ∃ u,
                    (KummerTheory.kummer (ell ^ k) K Ω) (x ^ m) = (KummerTheory.kummer (ell ^ k) K Ω) (y ^ m) ^ u ∧
                      (KummerTheory.kummer (ell ^ k) K Ω) q = (KummerTheory.kummer (ell ^ k) K Ω) r ^ u) →
                ↑x • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v = ↑y • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (x y : Kˣ),
  ↑x • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v = ↑y • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v →
    CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑x = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑y

∀ {K : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field Ω] [inst_2 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_3 : IsGalois K Ω]
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (q : Kˣ),
  CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (k : ℕ) [inst_4 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots (3 ^ k) K Ω],
      Nat.Coprime 4 (3 ^ k) ∧
        (KummerTheory.kummer (3 ^ k) K Ω) (q ^ 4) = (KummerTheory.kummer (3 ^ k) K Ω) q ^ 4 ∧
          ↑(q ^ 4) • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v ≠ ↑q • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (q : Kˣ),
  ↑4 * CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q →
    ¬CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q = 0 → False

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (q : Kˣ) (i j J : ℕ),
  i ≤ J →
    j ≤ J →
      (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑(q ^ i ^ 2) - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑(q ^ j ^ 2)).natAbs ≤
        (CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑q).natAbs * J ^ 2

∀ {k : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Field Ω]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k F] [inst_4 : Algebra F Ω] [inst_5 : Algebra k Ω] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower k F Ω]
  (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (hk : ∀ (c : k), (algebraMap k Ω) c ∈ A) [inst_7 : Algebra k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)]
  (hkres : ∀ (c : k), (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap k Ω) c, ⋯⟩ = (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c)
  [inst_8 : IsGalois F Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [inst_10 : Algebra.IsIntegral k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)],
  (∀ (a : F) (ha : (algebraMap F Ω) a ∈ A),
      ∃ c, (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap F Ω) a, ha⟩ = (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c) →
    ∀ (n u : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) [inst_11 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n F Ω]
      [inst_12 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)] (f g : Fˣ) (a b : kˣ)
      (hf : (algebraMap F Ω) ↑f ∈ A),
      (algebraMap F Ω) ↑f⁻¹ ∈ A →
        ∀ (hg : (algebraMap F Ω) ↑g ∈ A),
          (algebraMap F Ω) ↑g⁻¹ ∈ A →
            (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap F Ω) ↑f, hf⟩ = (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) ↑a →
              (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap F Ω) ↑g, hg⟩ = (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) ↑b →
                CoreDecompositionBridge.reducedClass A hk hkres n hn f =
                    CoreDecompositionBridge.reducedClass A hk hkres n hn g ^ u →
                  (KummerTheory.kummer n k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) a =
                    (KummerTheory.kummer n k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) b ^ u
